audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 John text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for advocate, commandment, love/hate sibling, world-desire, antichrist language, anointing, remaining.

verses.restored: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin/misalign. And if anyone does sin/misalign, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Messiah righteous/just.

familiar.text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

modern.text: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

original.text: Τεκνία μου, ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε. καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ, παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον,

verses.restored: And he is atoning mercy concerning our sins/misalignments, and not concerning ours only but also concerning whole world.

familiar.text: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

modern.text: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

original.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ἱλασμός ἐστιν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν, οὐ περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ ὅλου τοῦ κόσμου.

verses.restored: And by this we know that we have known him: if we keep his commands.

familiar.text: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

modern.text: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.

original.text: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν, ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν.

verses.restored: The one saying, I have known him, and not keeping his commands, is a liar, and truth is not in this one.

familiar.text: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

modern.text: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

original.text: ὁ λέγων ⸀ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτὸν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ μὴ τηρῶν ψεύστης ἐστίν, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν·

verses.restored: But whoever keeps his word, truly in this one the love of the Divine has been completed. By this we know that we are in him.

familiar.text: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

modern.text: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:

original.text: ὃς δʼ ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον, ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ τετελείωται. ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐσμεν·

verses.restored: The one saying to remain in him ought also to walk just as that one walked.

familiar.text: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

modern.text: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked. A New Commandment

original.text: ὁ λέγων ἐν αὐτῷ μένειν ὀφείλει καθὼς ἐκεῖνος περιεπάτησεν καὶ ⸀αὐτὸς περιπατεῖν.

verses.restored: Beloved, I write not a new command to you but an old command that you had from beginning; the old command is the word that you heard.

familiar.text: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

modern.text: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.

original.text: ⸀Ἀγαπητοί, οὐκ ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ἀλλʼ ἐντολὴν παλαιὰν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ παλαιά ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ⸀ἠκούσατε.

verses.restored: Again I write a new command to you, which is true in him and in you, because darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

familiar.text: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

modern.text: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.

original.text: πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει.

verses.restored: The one saying to be in the light and hating one's sibling is in darkness until now.

familiar.text: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

modern.text: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.

original.text: ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι.

verses.restored: The one loving one's sibling remains in the light, and there is no stumbling in that one.

familiar.text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

modern.text: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.

original.text: ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει, καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν·

verses.restored: But the one hating one's sibling is in darkness and walks in darkness and does not know where one goes, because darkness blinded one's eyes.

familiar.text: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

modern.text: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

original.text: ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ, καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: I write to you, little children, because the sins/misalignments have been released/forgiven you through his name.

familiar.text: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

modern.text: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.

original.text: Γράφω ὑμῖν, τεκνία, ὅτι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι διὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ·

verses.restored: I write to you, fathers, because you have known the One from beginning. I write to you, young ones, because you have overcome the harmful one.

familiar.text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

modern.text: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.

original.text: γράφω ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· γράφω ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.

verses.restored: I wrote to you, children, because you have known the Father. I wrote to you, fathers, because you have known the One from beginning. I wrote to you, young ones, because you are strong, and the word of the Divine remains in you, and you have overcome the harmful one.

familiar.text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

modern.text: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one. Do Not Love the World

original.text: ⸀ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, παιδία, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν πατέρα· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι ἰσχυροί ἐστε καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν μένει καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.

verses.restored: Do not love the world-system nor the things in the world-system. If anyone loves the world-system, the love of the Father is not in that one.

familiar.text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

modern.text: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

original.text: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ. ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον, οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ πατρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ·

verses.restored: Because everything in the world-system—the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the boastfulness of life— is not from the Father but from the world-system.

familiar.text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

modern.text: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.

original.text: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονεία τοῦ βίου, οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός, ἀλλὰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐστίν·

verses.restored: And the world-system is passing away, and its desire; but the one doing the will of the Divine remains into the age.

familiar.text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

modern.text: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever. Beware of Antichrists

original.text: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία αὐτοῦ, ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.restored: Little children, it is last hour; and just as you heard that antichrist/opposing-Messiah comes, even now many opposing-Messiah figures have come; from this we know that it is last hour.

familiar.text: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

modern.text: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.

original.text: Παιδία, ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν, καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ⸀ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἀντίχριστοι πολλοὶ γεγόνασιν· ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν.

verses.restored: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us; but it happened so that they might be manifest, that they all are not of us.

familiar.text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

modern.text: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.

original.text: ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξῆλθαν, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν· εἰ γὰρ ⸂ἐξ ἡμῶν ἦσαν⸃, μεμενήκεισαν ἂν μεθʼ ἡμῶν· ἀλλʼ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν πάντες ἐξ ἡμῶν.

verses.restored: And you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all know.

familiar.text: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

modern.text: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

original.text: καὶ ὑμεῖς χρῖσμα ἔχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου ⸀καὶ οἴδατε ⸀πάντες·

verses.restored: I did not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because every lie is not from truth.

familiar.text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

modern.text: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.

original.text: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν, καὶ ὅτι πᾶν ψεῦδος ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἔστιν.

verses.restored: Who is the liar except the one denying that Jesus is the Messiah? This is the antichrist/opposing-Messiah, the one denying the Father and the Son.

familiar.text: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

modern.text: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.

original.text: τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ χριστός; οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος, ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱόν.

verses.restored: Everyone denying the Son does not have the Father either; the one confessing the Son has the Father also.

familiar.text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

modern.text: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well. Remain in Christ

original.text: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν υἱὸν οὐδὲ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει· ⸂ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει⸃.

verses.restored: As for you, what you heard from beginning, let it remain in you. If what you heard from beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

familiar.text: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

modern.text: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.

original.text: ⸀ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἐν ὑμῖν μενέτω· ἐὰν ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἠκούσατε, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ μενεῖτε.

verses.restored: And this is the promise that he promised us: age-long life.

familiar.text: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

modern.text: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.

original.text: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν, τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον.

verses.restored: These things I wrote to you concerning those leading you astray.

familiar.text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

modern.text: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.

original.text: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: And as for you, the anointing that you received from him remains in you, and you have no need that anyone teach you; but as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true and is not lie, and just as it taught you, remain in him.

familiar.text: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

modern.text: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.

original.text: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ⸂μένει ἐν ὑμῖν⸃, καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ὡς τὸ ⸀αὐτοῦ χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων, καὶ ἀληθές ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ψεῦδος, καὶ καθὼς ἐδίδαξεν ὑμᾶς, ⸀μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ.

verses.restored: And now, little children, remain in him, so that if he is manifested we may have boldness and not be shamed from him at his presence/arrival.

familiar.text: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

modern.text: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.

original.text: Καὶ νῦν, τεκνία, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἵνα ⸀ἐὰν φανερωθῇ ⸀σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: If you know that he is righteous/just, you know that everyone doing righteousness/justice has been born from him.

familiar.text: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

modern.text: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.

original.text: ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν, γινώσκετε ⸀ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται.

translation_notes: Antichrist language is rendered opposing-Messiah and must not be used as paranoia or target-mapping.
World-system is used for kosmos where it means disordered desire-system, not creation itself.
Remaining/abiding is central: meno as relational continuity in Father/Son/truth/anointing.
